question.latex: A salt with few drops of conc. HCl gives apple green colour in flame test. The group precipitate of the salt is dissolved in acetic acid and treated with $K_2CrO_4$ to give yellow precipitate. When the sodium carbonate extract of the salt solution is heated with conc. $HNO_3$ and ammonium molybdate, it resulted a canary yellow precipitate.
